t4.text: Picked · Style Q, with the earlier pick P

n7.text: A as base. Hero from F (40px, 600, -0.04em). Main background #fafafa from F, navbar stays white. Diff colors from D (#86efac / #fca5a5 marks, #dcfce7 / #fee2e2 / #fef9c3 rows). Disabled toggle as the extension popup: track #f3f4f6, white knob, label #6b7280, no fade. Shell max-width 1280px, fluid below.

n9.text: Token names follow the extension's styles.css, values are Q's, so the extension migrates by editing values, not renaming. Orange = the extension's value changes (Tailwind gray to neutral ink). Green = new token. Left off on purpose: tokens Q never decided (purple secondary, status colors, larger shadows) and the dark set. web/public/tokens.css is the source of truth, and this board documents it.

n10.text: Motion needs Play: press Play on the board, then click and hover. The same two pages also open as plain HTML from design/preview in the repo.

n8.text: Q = P with two changes from developer.apple.com/design. Neutral ink: text #1d1d1f, secondary #6e6e73, light fill #f5f5f7 (read from their CSS); border #e5e5e7 and tertiary #a1a1a6 are derived to match. Hero letter-spacing -0.02em, since the system stack renders SF on Apple devices and SF is already tight. Blue accent, diff colors, toggle unchanged.
